import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file path
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_21/test_0.csv"
    
    # Load source data
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    
    # Inspect columns of source0 (for clarity, not strictly necessary)
    # print(df0.columns)
    
    # Transformation plan:
    # - Target schema: ['Major_category': string, 'Median': float]
    # - From source0, group by 'Major_category'
    # - Aggregate 'Median' by average (mean) because Median column has many nulls and many distinct values
    # - Resulting dataframe should have one row per Major_category with the average Median
    
    # Group by Major_category and calculate average Median
    df_target = df0.groupby('Major_category', as_index=False)['Median'].mean()
    
    # Rename columns to match target schema exactly (already matching)
    # Ensure Median is float
    df_target['Median'] = df_target['Median'].astype(float)
    
    # Output path
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_21/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    
    # Save to CSV without index
    df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
